sources.title: Government of Grenada, Cabinet Office, Grenada's Public Holidays - 2026 (September 2025; the Government's page https://www.gov.gd/documents/cabinet-office/public-holidays-2026)
sources.said: 1. New Year's Day Thursday, 1st January; 2. Independence Day (52nd Anniversary of Grenada's Independence) Saturday, 7th February; 3. Good Friday Friday, 3rd April; 4. Easter Monday Monday, 6th April; 5. Labour Day Friday, 1st May; 6. Whit Monday Monday, 25th May; 7. Corpus Christi Thursday, 4th June; 8. Emancipation Day (August 1st, 1834) Saturday, 1st August; 9. Carnival Monday Monday, 10th August; 10. Carnival Tuesday Tuesday 11th August; 11. National Heroes' Day Monday 19th October; 12. Thanksgiving Day Sunday, 25th October; 13. Christmas Day Friday, 25th December; 14. Boxing Day Saturday, 26th December. NB. When a Bank holiday falls on a Sunday, the Monday immediately following shall be observed. Carvel Lett (Ms.), Secretary to the Cabinet.
